content.comment_body: Does the [product_name] module offer any high-speed inputs? I couldn't find details on this.
From the manual (page 39, edition 3/2009): Fast digital inputs are I3/I4/I5/I6. For [product_name] modules such as 12/24 RC/RCo and 12/24o, the max input frequency has increased from 2 kHz to 5 kHz.

Hello [user_name]! I'm not certain if you mean the same feature, but [product_name] modules in the [article_no] series provide 4 high-speed inputs or counters, supporting up to 5 kHz. You can find more details in the manual (page 40) or at [url]. Hope this is useful. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are trying to confirm if [product_name] modules have high-speed input capability, and what those specifications are. The discussion shows confusion due to limited or unclear information in official documents. Some users note that selected [product_name] variants, such as specific versions like 12/24 RC/RCo and [article_no] series, can operate at higher input frequencies (up to 5 kHz). There is a need for clearer documentation about hardware differences between versions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want straightforward and comprehensive documentation regarding the high-speed digital input features and technical specifications for various [product_name] module versions.
